BiblicalUsage: Hannah was the wife of Elkanah and the mother of Samuel, and her name means grace. She was loved and yet childless, and she prayed in the temple so long and so silently that Eli thought she was drunken. She spoke in her heart, only her lips moved, and then she prayed the prayer that begins my heart rejoiceth in the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hannah's prayer is the model of praying when no one can hear the words: she did not perform her grief, she poured it out before the LORD, and He remembered her. I hold that God hears the prayer spoken only in the heart, and Hannah proves it.
